items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-09-01
items.q: Noble Sissel, I work with him. We're rehearsing with him.

ctx.x: No. But what kind of brass band? Louie learned his reading from that woman he married, Lil. Lil Armstrong? Yeah, Louie got all his learning from Lil. About music, I'm telling you what I know. Well, now. But you got to give it to him. Louis was an apt fellow. Still apt. Heads, you know. Louis was so apt until if he, like, fellas now go to make a note and miss it, they might get mad and say, oh shucks or something like that. But Louis wouldn't. Louis would make a mistake on a horn and bust out and laugh and say,…
Yeah, it was Miramac, you see, yeah.
